name: Summon Extraplanar Dragon
body:
School conjuration (summoning) [see text]; Level arcanist 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, bard/skald 5, cleric/oracle/warpriest 5, shaman 5, summoner 5, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, M (a large bag, a gold coin and a single dragon’scale), DF

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./ 2 levels)
Effect one summoned dragon
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell summons an extraplanar dragon. It appears where you designate and acts immediately, on your turn. It attacks your opponents to the best of its ability. If you can communicate with the dragon, you can direct it not to attack, to attack particular enemies, or to perform other actions. The spell conjures one of the dragons from the summon extraplanar dragon I list on the below table. You choose which kind of dragon to summon, and you can choose a different one each time you cast the spell.

A summoned extraplanar dragon cannot summon or otherwise conjure another creature, nor can it use any teleportation or planar travel abilities. Creatures cannot be summoned into an environment that cannot support them. Creatures summoned using this spell cannot use spells or spell-like abilities that duplicate spells with expensive material components (such as wish).

Summon Extraplanar Dragon II

School conjuration (summoning); Level arcanist 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, bard/skald 6, cleric/oracle/warpriest 6, shaman 6, summoner 6, witch 6

As summon extraplanar dragon I, except that you can summon one creature from the summon extraplanar dragon II list or 1d3 creatures from the summon extraplanar dragon I list.

Summon Extraplanar Dragon III

School conjuration (summoning); Level arcanist 7, sorcerer/wizard 7, cleric/oracle 7, shaman 7, witch 7

As summon extraplanar dragon I, except that you can summon one creature from the summon extraplanar dragon III list, 1d3 creatures from the summon extraplanar dragon II list, or 1d4+1 creatures from a lower-level list.

Summon Extraplanar Dragon IV

School conjuration (summoning); Level arcanist 8, sorcerer/wizard 8, cleric/oracle 8, shaman 8, witch 8

As summon extraplanar dragon I, except that you can summon one creature from the summon extraplanar dragon IV list, 1d3 creatures from the summon extraplanar dragon III list, or 1d4+1 creatures from a lower-level list.

Summon Extraplanar Dragon V

School conjuration (summoning); Level arcanist 9, sorcerer/wizard 9, cleric/oracle 9, shaman 9, witch 9

As summon extraplanar dragon I, except that you can summon one creature from the summon extraplanar dragon V list, 1d3 creatures from the summon extraplanar dragon IV list, or 1d4+1 creatures from a lower-level list.
